name: Chitrak Haritaki

sections.introduction: Chitrak Haritaki is a famous herbal formulation that is prepared from the mixture of effective herbs. Out of that fruitful herbs, Haritaki and Chitrak are very important herbs of this formulation.
sections.ingredients:
Chitrak – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Amla – Phyllanthus emblica 
 Guduchi – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula. 
 Trikatu – Pepper, Long pepper and Ginger 
 Cinnamon – Cinnamomum cassia 
 Patra – Cinnamomum tamala 
 Yavakshara 
 Dashamoola 
 Jaggery 
 Honey 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take the ingredients Chitrak, Amla, Guduchi, Dasamoola, make its decoction up to 4.8 litres. 
 Now mix the decoction with 4.8 kg jaggery and 3.07 kg  haritaki. 
 Heat the above mixture till got the semi-solid consistency. 
 Now added this mixture into 96 grams of Trikatu, Patra, Cinnamon, Yavakshara and 384 grams of honey. 
 The formulation is prepared.
sections.dose:
5 to 10 grams, one to two times a day, after meals with milk. 
 For children below 5 years of age – 1 to 2 grams 
 For age of 5 to 12 years – up to 5 grams
sections.indications:

sections.contraindications:
Over dose can cause stomach irritation 
 Avoid in pregnancy and lactation. 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Chitrak Haritaki 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali Nasa roga – 31-33. 
 Introduction 
 Chitrak Haritaki is a famous herbal formulation that is prepared from the mixture of effective herbs. Out of that fruitful herbs, Haritaki and Chitrak are very important herbs of this formulation. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Chitrak – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Amla – Phyllanthus emblica 
 Guduchi – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula. 
 Trikatu – Pepper, Long pepper and Ginger 
 Cinnamon – Cinnamomum cassia 
 Patra – Cinnamomum tamala 
 Yavakshara 
 Dashamoola 
 Jaggery 
 Honey 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take the ingredients Chitrak, Amla, Guduchi, Dasamoola, make its decoction up to 4.8 litres. 
 Now mix the decoction with 4.8 kg jaggery and 3.07 kg  haritaki. 
 Heat the above mixture till got the semi-solid consistency. 
 Now added this mixture into 96 grams of Trikatu, Patra, Cinnamon, Yavakshara and 384 grams of honey. 
 The formulation is prepared. 
 
 Dose 
 
 5 to 10 grams, one to two times a day, after meals with milk. 
 For children below 5 years of age – 1 to 2 grams 
 For age of 5 to 12 years – up to 5 grams 
 
 Indications 
 
 Chronic respiratory problems 
 Asthma 
 Bloating 
 Bronchitis 
 Tuberculosis 
 Intestinal worms 
 Low digestive power 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dose can cause stomach irritation 
 Avoid in pregnancy and lactation. 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
